integrity: Exact formulas proven from the block-power identity, finite-field Jordan centralizers and the q-binomial normalization. Seven finite direct-power experiments corroborate but do not prove the infinite-dimensional family. No independent validation has been carried out.
scientific_limitations: Counts nilpotency indices of all restricted-range linear maps for positive range dimension and codimension, not their entire ambient Jordan partitions or conjugacy orbits; the short closed near-maximal formula requires 2s<k. Classical nilpotent matrix counts and one-column affine analogues are credited as prior ingredients. Broader parabolic literature may cover specialized consequences.
title: Nilpotency-index spectrum and Bernoulli edge law for finite restricted-range endomorphisms
